_what: The Pebble Board — a community noticeboard on the street, and the editions pinned to it. Pebbling is Amythest Schaber's locution, documented by Stimpunks; a pebble is anything you bring somebody because it made you think of them.
_fixture: THE FRAME IS CONSTANT AND THE PAPER IS NOT. The board, its lamp, its glass and its plate belong to the street and stay put across every edition; what is pinned to it is that edition's own world and shares nothing with the next. This is the Arcade's argument arriving a second time and it is the SECOND, not a licence for a third: a noticeboard, like a cabinet, is one body with different things behind the glass. Each edition still gets its own share card, because the card is where a shortcut would be invisible.
_rotation: A new gathering, not a clock. An edition is dated by the day it was collected, and a board nobody has pinned to in a while is an honest board rather than a stale one. When a new edition goes up, the outgoing one is written to its own page and joins the rack at the foot of the board.
_source: 2026-06-25 gathering. Assembled by Norah Hobbs in the WordPress block editor and rebuilt as a static page with Claude in June 2026; carried onto this street on 2026-09-21. Every video id below was resolved against YouTube's own watch page on 2026-09-21 — status, playableInEmbed, runtime, title and channel — and NOT typed from memory. Two came back wrong and are recorded as such.
_typefaces: NORAH'S DESIGN, WITH TWO FACES SUBSTITUTED, 2026-09-21, Ryan's call. Her Atkinson Hyperlegible stays and is now self-hosted — it is the Braille Institute's low-vision face, so swapping the body text would be an access regression rather than a style choice. Her Caveat and Special Elite had to go: Caveat is the Faery Yurt's hand and Special Elite is the Zine Table's typewriter, and a punk-paper noticeboard set in the zine's own typewriter is precisely the collapse this street refuses. Gloria Hallelujah and Josefin Sans in their place. Recorded here rather than implied in a diff, for the same reason the one colour of Helen's that this repo changed is written up in four places.
_photographs: The photographs are NOT under this site's CC BY-SA licence and are governed by data/polaroids.json and tools/make-polaroids.py, the same as every other photograph here. Consent, withdrawal and the young-person policy live there, not in this file.
_artwork: Community artwork carries its maker's name and a recorded permission. Sharing a drawing at a gathering is not the same as agreeing to have it published on a public site, so 'maker_agreed' is a separate fact from 'maker' and the tool refuses without it.

memory.name: Om Malik
memory.credit: shared for Ryan afterward, as they were unable to attend the gathering — this is truly important to all of Stimpunks
quote: Without my recently departed friend Om Malik, WordPress arguably wouldn't still exist. Automattic… wouldn't exist. Stimpunks probably wouldn't exist. I sold part of Automattic to fund Stimpunks. We certainly wouldn't have been able to pay staff all these years without Om.
When the wealthiest men in tech tried to return to colonialism, Om made the wickedness of their plan plain to the world. His words changed global plans.
Be like Om. Remember beyond the mythology. Forgetting is a tool of white supremacy.
memory.closer: May his memory be a revolution.

cards.title: About
cards.more: A foundational voice in Autistic self-advocacy. On being cognitively, physically, developmentally, and psychiatrically disabled, using a communication device, and refusing to be flattened into one story: “every person is different, even a person with a collection of labels identical to mine.”

cards.title: Sigil
cards.more: A little detour into symbol-magic: sigils as condensed intentions, from medieval grimoires to chaos magic to corporate logos. Came up alongside a stash of hand-drawn symmetrical patterns.

cards.title: Focaccia from Overproofed Sourdough
cards.more: Mind-blowing fact of the gathering: focaccia is just what happens when sourdough gets away from you. Nothing wasted, just redirected.

cards.title: Now That's What I Call Music!
cards.more: A wave of shared nostalgia for the compilation CDs a lot of us grew up with — the official home of the series, for anyone who wants to fall down that hallway again.

cards.title: Informed vs. Educated

The story is the pebble; the screenshot was never ours. Card kept, image dropped, 2026-09-21.

cards.title: Seen & Celebrated
cards.credit: The Brighter Days Ahead Foundation, via Ariana Grande
cards.more: Stimpunks Foundation was named a grantee of the Seen & Celebrated Fund, tied to the Eternal Sunshine tour's Austin stop. Ariana Grande reshared it herself: “Stimpunks is a mutual aid organization by and for disabled & neurodivergent people that provides educational resources, accessibility tools, and creator grants.” Norah & Chelsea bought hoodies to celebrate.
